comments.comment: 96027a48: If the variable DG is defined and its value is greater than 9, execute the code block. The code block calls the routine F^DIE17 and sets variable Y to the up-arrow character. It then sets DQ to 7, calls the label X7, checks if Y is undefined or equal to the up-arrow character. If either condition is true, it goes to label A. Otherwise, it sets X to Y, sets DIC(0) to 'F', and sets DW to the value of DQ. Finally, it executes the routine OUT^DIE17.
